theDOUBLINGARGUMENTWASTESTEDANDITHOLDS.whatFIX155ARGUED: 216 placements against 108 distinct FlatWidget names is not a doubled placement, because resource dictionaries are per page and the two pinned sources number their appearances independently so the name sets coincide.

theDOUBLINGARGUMENTWASTESTEDANDITHOLDS.corroborationONE_thePerPageDistributionI: The pinned CR-65 carries /Widget annotations per page [20,12,8,8,12,21,26,1], total 108. The pinned C-10-CRIMINAL carries [40,35,33], total 108. The delivered packet's placement distribution is [20,12,8,8,12,21,26,1,40,35,33] - the exact concatenation, page for page. Every source widget yields exactly one flattened placement on its own page. A doubling would have produced 432, or a per-page distribution that did not match either source.
theDOUBLINGARGUMENTWASTESTEDANDITHOLDS.corroborationTWO_everySHAREDNAMEBINDSADI: All 108 names in the CR-65 half also appear in the C-10 half. Of those 108 shared names, the number binding the SAME object reference in both halves is 0 and the number binding a DIFFERENT object reference is 108. Example: FlatWidget-7098480789 is declared on page 1 as '72 0 R' and on page 9 as '425 0 R'. 193 distinct appearance objects are bound across the document, the remainder being identical blank appearances legitimately shared within a document half.
theDOUBLINGARGUMENTWASTESTEDANDITHOLDS.aLATENTFRAGILITYRECORDEDNOTSCORED: The flattener's name generator is seeded per document, so two documents composed into one packet produce the SAME 108 names. Nothing is wrong in the delivered bytes - PDF resource dictionaries are page-scoped, so the collision is invisible and harmless here. But it is harmless only by that scoping. Any future change that hoists FlatWidget XObjects to a shared or inherited resource dictionary, or that composes two documents onto ONE page, would silently bind 108 appearances to the wrong objects with no counter moving. Recorded for the integrator; it is not a defect in these bytes and is not scored against either family.

theALABAMAROUTEELECTIONDIVERGENCE_THISLA.theQUESTION: al-trafficking-set ticks C-10-CRIMINAL Check Box2.2, the sworn request for waiver of the expungement petition administrative filing fee. al-felony-dwop-set discloses all three printed relief requests and ticks none. FIX155 said both treatments are consistent with the record and flagged the divergence rather than changing the sibling. Is one of them wrong?
theALABAMAROUTEELECTIONDIVERGENCE_THISLA.theRECORDDOESNOTWARRANTTHEDIVERGENCE_MEA: The two tracks' `rules` objects in AL.memo.json are BYTE-IDENTICAL - filing, fees, feeWaiver, notice, service, participantSignature and notarization, all seven, character for character. Their fee_waiver components are also identical in the fields that govern this election: role fee_waiver, requirement 'conditional', conditionDescription 'Where indigency is claimed.', officialFormId C-10-CRIMINAL. The two tracks differ substantially elsewhere - authority, eligibleDispositions, eligibleRecordTypes, waitingPeriods, participantInputs, selfHelpStopConditions, supportingDocuments - but on the fee-waiver question they say the same words. So the divergence is NOT warranted by the two tracks' records. FIX155's stated ground for it is a fact about al-felony-dwop-set's own GUIDE ('this family's own guide already makes filing the affidavit conditional'), not about its record, and FIX155 does not claim otherwise; but a build decision resting on a guide sentence is not a record-warranted divergence, and this return does not treat it as one.
theALABAMAROUTEELECTIONDIVERGENCE_THISLA.whichTREATMENTISWRONG: al-trafficking-set. al-felony-dwop-set's treatment is correct and should be the one the sibling is brought to, not the reverse.
why: The record conditions the waiver on indigency being CLAIMED. 'Where indigency is claimed' is a participant fact. The route settles WHICH of the three printed requests is the relevant one - and it does, decisively: the third is the only one of the three that mentions an expungement petition, and it is the one rules.feeWaiver names the instrument for. The route does not settle WHETHER to make it. al-trafficking-set's field map records Check Box2.2 as routeDetermined true with factId route.fee_waiver_relief. That is a claim the route determines it. The record it cites does not.

The sentence beside the box is sworn and first-person: 'I, because of financial hardship, am unable to pay the expungement petition administrative filing fee and request that these fees be waived.' It sits on a form captioned AFFIDAVIT OF SUBSTANTIAL HARDSHIP, above a signature the participant supplies. Ticking it is the platform making a sworn assertion about the participant's finances. al-trafficking-set's own field map records factAvailable false throughout that affidavit: the packet does not hold the fact it is asserting.

The contrast inside the same form settles the principle. Check Box1.0, the STATE OF ALABAMA caption branch, IS route-determined - rules.filing names the circuit court and nothing about the participant stands between the route and the caption. Both families tick it, and both are right to. Check Box2.2 has a participant fact standing between the route and the election. Both families' records draw that line the same way; only one family's build honours it.

The 'conditional' component is delivered UNCONDITIONALLY. All four al-trafficking-set fixtures carry C-10 pages 1-3, 11 pages each, and all four carry the tick. So the record's condition is not discharged by the build at all; it is discharged only by an instruction in step 5 telling the participant to 'remove the affidavit from the packet' if they are not claiming hardship. A participant who does not read or does not act on that sentence files a sworn financial-hardship statement they never made. The felony-dwop failure mode is the opposite and is recoverable: an affidavit with no box ticked asks the court for nothing, and that family's guide says so in exactly those words.

It is the same defect class as the MUNICIPALITY OF direction VF52 caught and FIX155 repaired - the packet putting a statement into a sworn filing that the record does not authorise - differing only in that MUNICIPALITY OF contradicted rules.filing outright while this one outruns a condition rules.fees states.

theALABAMAROUTEELECTIONDIVERGENCE_THISLA.whatWOULDSATISFYIT: Either (a) reclassify C-10-CRIMINAL:Check Box2.2 on al-trafficking-set to routeDetermined false with the printed request recorded verbatim, stop ticking it, and give that family the disclosure section al-felony-dwop-set now carries - the byte-moving option, which costs the fresh central raster that family already owes anyway; or (b) an owner determination, recorded as one, that a conditional fee_waiver component delivered into a packet MAY carry its own relief election pre-made, which would then have to be applied to both families and to every other route whose record conditions relief on a participant fact. This lane's view is that (a) is right and (b) should be refused. Either way it is not repairable by restating it: FIX155 already disclosed it accurately, and accurate disclosure of an unauthorised sworn election is not a cure for making it.

FIX155 was right to flag the divergence rather than resolve it across families; it was wrong to record both treatments as consistent with the record, because the record is one record and says one thing.

obligationFindings.ROUTE_OPTIONS: FAIL. THIS PACKET MAKES A SWORN ELECTION ITS RECORD DOES NOT AUTHORISE IT TO MAKE. It ticks C-10-CRIMINAL Check Box2.2, whose printed sentence, bound to that rectangle geometrically by this lane, is 'I, because of financial hardship, am unable to pay the expungement petition administrative filing fee and request that these fees be waived.' - a sworn first-person statement about the participant's finances, on a form captioned AFFIDAVIT OF SUBSTANTIAL HARDSHIP, above a signature the participant supplies. The record conditions that relief on a participant fact this packet does not hold: AL.memo.json track al-trafficking rules.fees reads '$500, or C-10-Criminal where indigency is CLAIMED' and the fee_waiver component's own requirement is 'conditional' with conditionDescription 'Where indigency is claimed.' The route settles WHICH of the three printed requests is relevant - and it does, decisively, the third being the only one that mentions an expungement petition. It does not settle WHETHER to make it. The field map nonetheless records Check Box2.2 routeDetermined TRUE with factId route.fee_waiver_relief. Compare Check Box1.0 on the same form: the STATE OF ALABAMA caption branch IS route-determined, because rules.filing names the circuit court and no participant fact stands between the route and the caption; this packet ticks it and is right to. THE TICK IS IN THE DELIVERED PIXELS, NOT ONLY IN A REPORT: at C-10 page 1 Check Box2.2, rect x 74.68-84.38 / y 554.86-564.56 pt, 300 dpi, grey<200, annotations drawn - all four of this family's fixtures read 710 px against the pinned source's 616 px, while both al-felony-dwop-set fixtures read 625 px at the identical rectangle. The +85 px is the mark. AGGRAVATING: the conditional component is delivered UNCONDITIONALLY. All four fixtures carry C-10 pages 1-3 and all four carry the tick, so the record's condition is discharged nowhere in the build - only by step 5 telling the participant to 'remove the affidavit from the packet' if they are not claiming hardship. A participant who does not read or does not act on that sentence files a sworn financial-hardship statement they never made, and the packet will have made it for them. THE DISCLOSURE IS NOT THE PROBLEM AND IS NOT THE CURE: this family discloses the election accurately - step 5 says the affidavit 'already elects' the request, and '## What this packet deliberately does not tick' names the other two boxes. Accurate disclosure of an unauthorised sworn election is not a cure for making it. This is the same class as the MUNICIPALITY OF direction VF52 caught on the sibling: the packet putting into a sworn filing something the record does not authorise. It differs only in that MUNICIPALITY OF contradicted rules.filing outright while this outruns a condition rules.fees states.
